metadata.name: workspace-naturalize-hero
metadata.description: Naturalize journey driving the deterministic realism compositor end-to-end against the real backend — the first AI-catalog op that runs to COMPLETION in CI with no model download. Navigates to /workspace, switches to Enhance mode, asserts the Naturalize action is discovered from AIService.ListAIOperations (enhancement category), loads a sample image, selects Naturalize (asserting its realism knob surfaces), and runs it. Because naturalize is backed by the in-process `builtin` provider over the weightless `naturalize-detail-v1` model (RequiresWeights == false), there is NO install gate: the run resolves synchronously-fast to a real result. Asserting the success state proves the full discovery -> select-model (builtin, always-installed) -> submit (POST /api/v1/ai/naturalize) -> durable job -> compositor -> persist -> in-canvas compose wiring works against the live API. This is the genuinely-runnable AI E2E the install-gated bg-removal/upscale journeys can only stub in CI. A broken AI discovery, a missing builtin provider, a regressed always-installed gate, or a compositor that errors all fail here.

assert.failure_message: The Naturalize action did not render — AIService.ListAIOperations discovery or the enhancement-category filter regressed.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 240; c.height = 160; const g = c.getContext('2d'); const grd = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 240, 0); grd.addColorStop(0, '#caa68a'); grd.addColorStop(1, '#e8d4c2'); g.fillStyle = grd; g.fillRect(0, 0, 240, 160); return new Promise((resolve) => { c.toBlob((blob) => { const file = new File([blob], 'smooth.png', { type: 'image/png' }); const input = document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-file-input"]'); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); resolve('loaded'); }, 'image/png'); }); })()
